findings.evidence: We use a tool called Google Analytics to help us understand how users interact with our website. It tells us aggregate usage and traffic information, such as how the site was accessed, how long visitors stayed, and the number of first-time visitors to the site. To learn more about Google Analytics and how it uses your data, please visit http://www.google.com/analytics/learn/privacy.html.
findings.rationale: The policy mentions using Google Analytics for understanding user interaction but does not specify sharing IP addresses and device IDs with Mixpanel.
